narrative.details:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
narrative.objectives: Return to Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
narrative.offerRewardText: Goodness, that sounds terrible!By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm more than worried about him!
